summary: Self-service automation portal maps job template properties to generated template metadata: Name becomes metadata.name (lowercase with hyphens) and metadata.title (copied), Description is copied to metadata.description, Labels become metadata.tags (lowercased, special characters replaced with hyphens), and metadata.namespace is hardcoded to default.
questions: How are job template names converted in auto-generated self-service templates?
Where do job template labels end up in a self-service template?
What namespace do auto-generated self-service templates use?

answer_card.title: Job template to self-service template metadata
answer_card.answer_md:
| Job template property | Generated field | Transformation |
|---|---|---|
| Name | `metadata.name` | lowercase with hyphens |
| Name | `metadata.title` | copied directly |
| Description | `metadata.description` | copied directly |
| Labels | `metadata.tags` | lowercase, special characters become hyphens |
| (none) | `metadata.namespace` | hardcoded to `default` |
